# portainer_edge_job (Data Source)

The `portainer_edge_job` data source allows you to look up an existing Portainer Edge job by its name.

## Example Usage

### Look up an Edge job by name

```hcl
data "portainer_edge_job" "backup" {
  name = "nightly-backup"
}

output "job_id" {
  value = data.portainer_edge_job.backup.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the edge job to look up in Portainer.

### Read-Only

- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression that schedules execution of the edge job.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the edge job.
